The width of the part (26.0 mm) exceeds the requirement R2 (|y| <= 16, which implies a max width of 32mm, but the design doc says base width is 30mm and narrowing to 20mm).
The mass (37.7 g) significantly exceeds the requirement R7 (mass <= 20 g).
The motor mount holes are not visible or correctly placed according to the design document's description of four holes at (120 +- 8, +-9.5).
The central shaft hole is missing or incorrectly implemented.
summary: The rendered part fails to implement the intended I-beam profile and motor mount features, resulting in a mass that is nearly double the allowed limit.
